snippet.title: MONOMOON trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

MONOMOON by @gentle-giant-games comes out this year!
